finalText:
The golden test is green, and the fix is in the code, not the test: `footprintArea` was skipping the closing edge of the ring (last vertex back to the first), so the 10 × 8 rectangle came out as 88 m² instead of 80.

The fix is a two-line change in `packages/geo-model3d/src/footprint-area.js`: the loop now covers every vertex and wraps around to the first one. The golden test and its expected value are untouched.

The `geo-model3d` vitest run passes (32 files, 107 tests); I did not run suites for other packages. Nothing else in the repo imports this function, so no other code is affected.

The change is not committed — say the word if you want it committed or pushed before the demo.
